name: draftr
description: Create, edit, review and export Draftr designs from your agent through the Draftr MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to your Draftr account to read designs, build screens from components and starter blocks, answer comments, wire prototypes and export finished work. People watching the file see the agent in presence while it works.
defaultPrompt: List my Draftr designs and summarize the latest one
Add a pricing section to my landing page in Draftr
Answer the open comments in my Draftr design
